Imgur images don't have any obvious consistency between jpegs. While they most likely pass images through a library just like slimgur there are probably differences between what slimgur uses and what imgur uses. It’s not easy identifying what Imgur does to “losslessly compress” JPEGs that are over 5 but under the hard limit of 20 MB, because of privacy concerns the final step of uploading is always the removal of all metadata from images. I would suspect optimizing the Huffman encoding used because that’s the only lossless step performed by the JPEG codec.

Voat on the other hand uses a very short timeout of 300 milliseconds to try and fetch an image that’s processed into a thumbnail. If Slimgr or other hosts take any longer your posts don’t get a thumbnail.
